subject: Virtual loop: ORBIT panel handoff + candidate's late availability
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Eve Torres <eve.torres@gmail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-18 08:15 AM -0700
Subject: Virtual loop: ORBIT panel handoff + candidate's late availability

Hi Eve — excited to move you into the next stage. We’re planning a full virtual onsite (ORBIT loop) on Thursday, July 20. Proposed structure below — total ~3.5 hrs with two short breaks.

- 9:00–9:30 AM PT: Intro + product conversation (Laura)
- 9:35–10:05 AM PT: System design (Logan)
- 10:05–10:20 AM PT: 15-minute break
- 10:20–10:50 AM PT: Deep dive / coding (Marissa)
- 10:55–11:25 AM PT: Cross-team collaboration + culture (panel: Laura + Logan + Marissa)

Can you confirm you’re available for that window? If not, send 2 alternate windows and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

I attached your CV and the run-of-show so you know what to expect. Let me know if you have accessibility needs or timezone issues.

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
Attachments: EveTorres_CV.pdf (resume, 240KB); orbit_full_run_of_show_v1.docx (agenda)

Thanks Priyom — really appreciate the details. I have a late conflict on July 20 (doctor appointment that morning ran long) and won’t be available until 10:30 AM PT. I can do any time after 10:30 that day, or alternative windows:

- Friday, July 21: 8:30–12:00 PT OR 1:30–4:00 PT
- Monday, July 24: 9:00–12:30 PT

If you can compress or move the earlier interviews to the afternoon that would work. Happy to be flexible.

Best,
Eve

Team — quick update: Eve has a conflict and is only available after 10:30 AM PT on July 20. She also offered Fri 7/21 or Mon 7/24 windows. Can we pivot to a compressed afternoon loop on 7/20 (start 10:45, end 2:00) or pick one alternate day?

Option A (compressed 7/20):
- 10:45–11:15: System design (Logan)
- 11:20–11:50: Deep dive / coding (Marissa)
- 11:50–12:05: Break / buffer
- 12:05–12:35: Intro + product (Laura)
- 12:40–1:10: Panel + cross-team / culture (Laura + Logan + Marissa)
- 1:15–1:45: Optional hiring manager wrap (Logan) or buffer for overrun

Option B: Move to Fri 7/21 or Mon 7/24; if we choose Fri we can keep morning conventional slots.

Please reply with availability or conflicts within the next 90 minutes; I need to lock rooms and send calendar invites to the candidate. If anyone absolutely can’t do 7/20 after 10:30, flag now and we’ll consider the alternate days.

Thanks —
Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

+1 to compressed 7/20 — I can make 10:45–11:50. One small note: I have a standing 1:30 PM sync I can’t move on Fri, so if we go with Option A that’s fine.

Also, quick ask — can we swap the coding deep dive to 11:20 if possible? I’ve got a brief conflict from 10:55–11:10 (internal incident ping), and shifting the blocks by 10 minutes makes the buffer tighter but workable.

> Option A (compressed 7/20):
> - 10:45–11:15: System design (Logan)

> - 11:50–12:05: Break / buffer

-M

Thanks all for the quick replies — locking Option A with the small shift Marissa requested. Calendar invites will go out in the next 10 minutes. Eve, thanks for accommodating — final schedule below (all PT):

- 10:45–11:15: System design — Logan Wright
- 11:00–11:30: Deep dive / coding — Marissa Cole
- 11:30–11:40: Buffer / break (10 min)
- 11:40–12:10: Intro + product conversation — Laura Bennett
- 12:15–12:45: Panel: cross-team collaboration + culture — Laura, Logan, Marissa
- 12:45–1:00: Hiring manager wrap / Q&A — Logan (optional)

Notes / logistics:
- Zoom link and calendar invites have been sent. Please accept so we can show updated availability to Ops.
- Interviewers: please keep your panel questions lean (3–4 prompts) so we stay on time.
- Eve: attached is the updated run-of-show and a copy of your resume we shared with the panel. If you want a relaxed start or a short break before the first session, we can nudge start time by 10 mins — say the word.

Attachments: orbit_full_run_of_show_v1.docx; EveTorres_CV.pdf

Thanks — see you Thursday.
